duration_periods.scope: Reported humanitarian-aid dispatch suspension through Kerem Shalom, 25–28 December 2023; eligibility as an intentional crossing restriction remains unresolved.
duration_periods.authority: OCHA attributes the interruption to security and coordination incidents, including a drone strike, aid seizures and uncoordinated Israeli prisoner/casualty transfers; the restricting action accounting for the full interval is not isolated.
duration_periods.basis: OCHA Flash Update 80 reports aid suspension from 25–28 December following security and coordination incidents. OCHA’s 29 December impact graphic explicitly dates resumed dispatch to 29 December. Neither passage isolates a continuous intentional crossing restriction responsible for the whole interruption.
duration_periods.qualification: The interruption and 29 December aid resumption are retained as reported facts. Numeric restriction duration is held because a continuous intentional restriction has not been established. An official order is not required: the existing codebook also permits source-supported coercive closures. The present accounts do not resolve whether that rule explains this entire aid-dispatch interval. Ordinary trade, passengers and durable restoration remain outside this phase.
duration_periods.review_type: REC50-R14 targeted original research, separate same-model source challenge and root adjudication completed; the OCHA products share an organisational origin; the accepted hold concerns eligibility, not the truth of the reported aid interruption.
